title: NASA’s Webb finds signs of Mars-sized worlds smashing together
caption:
Astronomers are using the James Webb Space Telescope to look back in time at violent planetary collisions. By analyzing the minerals in debris disks around young stars, they are learning how rocky worlds like our own were forged in the early solar system.

Source: Sciencedaily - NASA’s Webb finds signs of Mars-sized worlds smashing together
